description: Public calculator (NO token needed): compute all 8 compromised Hyrox 1 km lap splits (with preceding station fatigue multipliers, Pro/Doubles offsets, and Lap 1 overpacing blow-up cost) from a standalone 5K time using STRUGGL's 200,000-finisher decay model.

cns_penalty_sec_per_km.description: Extra sled/CNS peripheral fatigue penalty in seconds per km (0–35).

goal_time.description: Optional target Hyrox finish time as H:MM:SS (e.g. '1:18:00').

standalone_5k_time.description: Standalone open 5 km time as MM:SS (e.g. '21:30').

name: hyrox_splits
